main_text.p: de dignum sit: sed in Christo Jesu dante, ut & velimus & faciamus bona, et Spiritu suo sanctonos corroborate, omnia possumus, mundum & carnem vincimus, Sathanā quine-tiā pedibus calcamus. A Christo Jesu, quicunqp fuerunt & sunt alieni, virtutū umbras obtinuerūt, nō rem ipsam. Nō enim arbores malę fructus bonos proferre possunt. Videamus autē solicitē, ne dū vere negamus, Aristidis, Phocionis, Niciæ, Socratis virtutes perfectas fuisse: ipsi interim, q de fide in Christū Jesum opere tanto gloriamur, patriæ, Reipub. Academiis, minus quā isti exoterici, vel benefactis, vel inculpatę vi-tæ exemplo, præstemus. Magnū enim quiddam est, quod vox divina eiusmodi Aristarchis denunciauit: Regina Au-stri surget in judicio cum natione hac, & condemnabit eā: quod venerit à ter-minis terræ, ut audiret sapientiā Solo-monis: & ecce plus quàm Solomo est in hoc loco.
Tuo autē nomine, Vir magnifice & nobilissime, hęc Theologica opuscula, in Ba[?]

page.notes: Catchword "in Ba" at lower right is partly cut off; read as a word abbreviation, uncertain. The word "sanctonos" and "Sathanā" are read from a slightly blurred scan. No page number is printed. Running head "EPISTOLA" is set in letter-spaced capitals at the top.
